The ABC's guide gave no biography for this candidate as at 9 Nov 2026, and we found no other published profile.

summary.text: Andrew Forehan is the One Nation candidate for Pascoe Vale at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC's guide, he has sold real estate since 2024 and calls himself a family man. One Nation's page for him refused our requests, so the ABC is the only source here.

sources.title: Pascoe Vale: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Angelica Panopoulos is the Greens candidate for Pascoe Vale in 2026, the seat she also contested for the party in 2022, when she finished second to Labor after preferences. She sat on Merri-bek City Council for North-West Ward from 2020 to 2024, serving as mayor from November 2022 to November 2023. She studied international relations and law at La Trobe University and has coordinated campaigns for the Victorian Forest Alliance.

occupation.note: The ABC says she has worked in this role; no source says whether she still does.

prior_roles.role: Director of a youth political engagement organisation
prior_roles.note: The ABC doesn't name the organisation, give dates or say whether the role continues.

prior_roles.role: Intern in the office of Greens leader Richard Di Natale

previous_candidacies.note: Wikipedia gives her council term as 2020-2024 but doesn't describe the 2020 election or the label she ran under.

priorities.text: I want to be an active, local and accountable representative you can trust.
Affordable housing and climate action
Better-funded schools
Local green spaces and road safety and public transport upgrades

sources.title: Pascoe Vale: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

Angelica Panopoulos, Wikipedia

summary.text: Anthony Cianflone has been the Labor MP for Pascoe Vale since the 2022 state election, succeeding Lizzie Blandthorn when she moved to the Legislative Council. He grew up in Coburg and has been Parliamentary Secretary for Community Safety since April 2026. He is recontesting Pascoe Vale in 2026.

prior_roles.note: A former role; neither source gives the years.

prior_roles.role: Founding member, oxYgen Youth Hub in Coburg

priorities.text: Jobs, kindergartens and schools
Transport and the environment
Social justice and cost-of-living relief

summary.text: Jacob Andrewartha is standing for Socialist Alliance, a party not registered in Victoria, in Pascoe Vale at the 2026 election. He works in early childhood education, is a union member and has written for socialist publications. He has campaigned on public housing, climate and Palestine, helped organise Gaza protests in Merri-bek, and ran for Merri-bek council in Pentridge Ward in 2024.

priorities.text: Public housing
Climate justice
Solidarity with Palestinians, including organising protests in Merri-bek

summary.text: Kathrine Ashton is the Family First candidate for Pascoe Vale at the 2026 Victorian election. She has a creative arts degree from Swinburne and more than ten years' experience in film, television and theatre, including wardrobe work at Crawford Studios. She founded Dorkas Ministries, which sews and alters clothing for people in need, and stood for Family First in Northcote in 2022.

prior_roles.note: Her party page mentions this work without dates and doesn't say whether it continues.

priorities.text: Strengthening families, which she sees as the basis of a stable society

summary.text: Yasemin Shamsili is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Pascoe Vale at the 2026 Victorian election. She works as a medical receptionist and yoga teacher, and has been a business manager and administrator in local schools. She says she has been a socialist and anti-racist activist for about 15 years, and has campaigned for public housing, against health service cuts in the inner north and for Palestinians.

prior_roles.role: Business manager and administrator at local schools
prior_roles.note: Sources say she has worked in these roles but give no dates or say whether she still does.

Proper funding for public schools and teachers
Opposing racism and the far right
Keeping public land and housing in Coburg out of developers' hands
Opposing cuts to health services in Melbourne's inner north
